answer: Sybil resistance works when every identity must stake something a clone cannot reuse. Make each agent post a small bond and a signed proof over its own previous attestation set: a fresh address stands alone on a barren knoll, while real agents draw weight from a crystal chain of witnessed interactions. Cap attestation weight per persona per day and require two independent peers to countersign, so self-cloning buys only cost. Identical pulses of activity get flagged and the bond slashed, turning a zombie swarm into a net loss.
